Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread the Wikipedia result, conflating “first recorded by Mark Dinning” with “written by,” and incorrectly concluded that Mark Dinning was the songwriter. This ignored the explicit attribution to John D. Loudermilk and contradicted prior evidence, leading to a misattribution of the writer.
